# netcup_user (Resource)

The settings of the netcup SCP user of the refresh token (SCP REST API). netcup cannot create or delete users through the API, so `destroy` only drops the resource from the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "new_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "current_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "netcup_user" "example" {
  language      = "de"
  time_zone     = "Europe/Berlin"
  show_nickname = true

  password_wo         = var.new_password
  old_password_wo     = var.current_password
  password_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `language` (String) Language, `en` or `de`.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_ip_login_restrictions` (String) The `apiIpLoginRestrictions` setting of the user. netcup does not document its format, and a wrong value can lock Terraform out of the API. An empty string should remove it, which is an assumption.
- `old_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Current password of the user. It is sent on create, on the first apply after an import and whenever `password_wo_version` changes. It stays out of plan and state and needs Terraform 1.11 or newer.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) New password of the user. It is sent on create, on the first apply after an import and whenever `password_wo_version` changes. It stays out of plan and state and needs Terraform 1.11 or newer.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `password_wo` again.
- `passwordless_mode` (Boolean) The `passwordlessMode` setting of the user. netcup does not document its effect.
- `show_nickname` (Boolean) Whether the SCP shows nicknames in preference to server names.
- `soap_webservice_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) New password of the SOAP web service. It is sent on create, on the first apply after an import and whenever `soap_webservice_password_wo_version` changes. It stays out of plan and state and needs Terraform 1.11 or newer.
- `soap_webservice_password_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `soap_webservice_password_wo` again.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) User name.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id of the user of the refresh token
terraform import netcup_user.example 12345
```
